expect: ready = the record should be allowed to reach READY on these five checks; gaps = which of the five should be raised

notes.scope: Only the five new checks are scored here. A record coded ready may still be held by existing checks for other reasons; that is reported separately, not counted as an error of these checks.
notes.G2,G3,G5,G6: No source shows the approver's authority, so approver_authority_not_shown is expected as well.
